__help: A value left out (or a broken file): the default of the mod.
Every growth is shared out: attack x AtkR, defense x DefR, max HP x MHpR.
GrowRate: growth a growth turn, KillGrowRate: growth per monster of the type killed, by type (Common, Elite, BOSS, NPC).
PlayerAtk2Hp (S&M MonsterPropertiesDependOnPlayerProperties): HP from the attack of the player, by type.
AreaBonus: growth by area 1-13. RebirthAffect: growth per total grade of the rebirths.
Basis of a monster: x (1 + BasisGradeRate x (grade - 1)) x (1 + BasisGameLvlRate x (game level - 1)).
Growth with time: GrowRate x counter^GrowExponent (+ KillGrowRate x kills), x (1 + GrowGradeRate x (grade - 1)) x (1 + GrowGameLvlRate x (game level - 1)).
PlayerAffectSummon: summons of the player get this share of the player's Atk, Def, MHp and basis (Bas).
